 ;; --- Smart TAB Dispatcher (Doom Style) ---
(defun my/smart-tab-dwim ()
  "Smart TAB dispatcher: Minibuffer > Tempel > Corfu > Magit > Indent."
  (interactive)
  (cond
    ;; 1. Minibuffer: Keep Vertico completion behavior
    ((active-minibuffer-window)
     (if (and (bound-and-true-p vertico-mode) vertico--candidates)
         (vertico-insert)
       (minibuffer-complete)))

    ;; 2. Try to expand a tempel snippet at point
    ((condition-case nil (progn (tempel-expand) t) (user-error nil)))

    ;; 3. Corfu: If menu is open, TAB navigates between candidates
    ((and (bound-and-true-p corfu-mode) corfu--candidates)
     (corfu-next))

    ;; 4. Support for Magit (Toggle sections)
    ((derived-mode-p 'magit-mode)
     (magit-section-toggle (magit-current-section)))

    ;; 5. Final fallback: Standard indentation
    (t
     (indent-for-tab-command))))

 ;; --- Global and Evil Mapping ---
(global-set-key (kbd "TAB") 'my/smart-tab-dwim)

 ;; Ensure Evil Mode in Insert State uses this logic
  (with-eval-after-load 'evil
    (define-key evil-insert-state-map (kbd "TAB") 'my/smart-tab-dwim))

;; --- Doom-like "K" Documentation Lookup ---
(defun my/smart-lookup ()
  "Lookup documentation for the thing at point.
   1. Elisp: describe-symbol
   2. Org Src Block (Elisp): describe-symbol
   3. LSP / lsp-mode: lsp-describe-thing-at-point
   4. Fallback: evil-lookup"
  (interactive)
  (cond
   ;; 1. Emacs Lisp Mode
   ((derived-mode-p 'emacs-lisp-mode)
    (let ((sym (thing-at-point 'symbol)))
      (if sym (describe-symbol sym)
        (message "No symbol at point"))))

   ;; 2. Org Mode Source Blocks
   ((and (eq major-mode 'org-mode) (org-in-src-block-p))
    (let ((lang (car (org-babel-get-src-block-info)))
          (sym (thing-at-point 'symbol t)))
      (if (and (string= lang "emacs-lisp") sym)
          (describe-symbol (intern sym))
        (call-interactively #'evil-lookup))))

   ;; 3. LSP / lsp-mode
   ((bound-and-true-p lsp-mode)
    (lsp-describe-thing-at-point))

   ;; 4. Fallback
   (t
    (call-interactively #'evil-lookup))))

(with-eval-after-load 'evil
  (define-key evil-motion-state-map (kbd "K") #'my/smart-lookup))

;; Doom-like utility functions for file operations
(defun my/copy-this-file ()
  "Copy the current file to a new location."
  (interactive)
  (let* ((filename (buffer-file-name))
         (new-name (read-file-name "Copy file to: " filename)))
    (copy-file filename new-name 1)
    (find-file new-name)
    (message "Copied '%s' to '%s'" filename new-name)))

(defun my/move-this-file ()
  "Move or rename the current file to NEW-PATH."
  (interactive)
  (let* ((old-path (buffer-file-name))
         (new-path (read-file-name "Move file to: " old-path)))
    (if (not (and old-path (file-exists-p old-path)))
        (user-error "Buffer is not visiting any file")
      (let ((new-path (expand-file-name new-path)))
        (make-directory (file-name-directory new-path) t)
        (rename-file old-path new-path 1)
        (set-visited-file-name new-path t t)
        (message "File moved to %s" new-path)))))

(defun my/delete-this-file ()
  "Delete the current file and kill its buffer."
  (interactive)
  (let ((path (buffer-file-name)))
    (unless (and path (file-exists-p path))
      (user-error "Buffer is not visiting any file"))
    (when (y-or-n-p (format "Really delete %S?" (file-name-nondirectory path)))
      (delete-file path)
      (kill-buffer (current-buffer))
      (message "File deleted: %s" path))))

(defun my/create-file (filename)
  "Create a new file named FILENAME."
  (interactive "FCreate file: ")
  (if (file-exists-p filename)
      (find-file filename)
    (write-region "" nil filename)
    (find-file filename)
    (message "Created file: %s" filename)))

(defun my/copy-file-path ()
  "Copy the current file's path to the kill ring."
  (interactive)
  (let ((filename (or (buffer-file-name) (error "Buffer not visiting a file"))))
    (kill-new filename)
    (message "Copied: %s" filename)))

(defun my/copy-file-path-relative-to-project ()
  "Copy the current file's path relative to project root to the kill ring."
  (interactive)
  (let* ((filename (or (buffer-file-name) (error "Buffer not visiting a file")))
         (project-root (or (and (project-current) (project-root (project-current))) default-directory))
         (relative-path (file-relative-name filename project-root)))
    (kill-new relative-path)
    (message "Copied: %s" relative-path)))

(defun my/kill-all-buffers ()
  "Kill all buffers except the current one and special buffers."
  (interactive)
  (let ((current-buffer (current-buffer)))
    (dolist (buffer (buffer-list))
      (unless (or (eq buffer current-buffer)
                  (string-match-p "\*.*\*" (buffer-name buffer)))
        (kill-buffer buffer))))
    (message "Killed all buffers"))

(defun my/kill-other-buffers ()
  "Kill all buffers except the current one."
  (interactive)
  (let ((current-buffer (current-buffer)))
    (dolist (buffer (buffer-list))
      (unless (eq buffer current-buffer)
        (kill-buffer buffer))))
    (message "Killed other buffers"))

;; Terminal Launchers
(defun my/launch-alacritty (dir) (call-process-shell-command (format "alacritty --working-directory %s" (shell-quote-argument dir)) nil 0))

(defun my/open-terminal-here () (interactive) (my/launch-alacritty default-directory))
(defun my/open-terminal-in-project ()
  "Launch Alacritty terminal in the current project root."
  (interactive)
  (let ((project (project-current)))
    (if project
        (my/launch-alacritty (project-root project))
      (message "Not in a project"))))

    ;; --- Emacs Build Information ---
    (defun my/emacs-build-info ()
      "Display detailed information about Emacs build and features."
      (interactive)
      (with-output-to-temp-buffer "*Emacs Build Info*"
        (princ (format "Emacs Version: %s\n\n" emacs-version))
        (princ (format "System Configuration: %s\n\n" system-configuration))
        (princ "Compilation Options:\n")
        (princ "====================\n")
        (dolist (opt (split-string system-configuration-options))
          (princ (format "  %s\n" opt)))
        (princ "\n\nNative Compilation:\n")
        (princ "===================\n")
        (princ (format "  Available: %s\n" (if (featurep 'native-compile) "Yes" "No")))
        (when (featurep 'native-compile)
          (princ (format "  Version: %s\n" native-comp-version))
          (princ (format "  ELN Load Path: %s\n" native-comp-eln-load-path)))
        (princ "\n\nFeatures:\n")
        (princ "=========\n")
        (dolist (feature features)
          (when (string-match-p "^\\(jansson\\|libxml2\\|sqlite\\|json\\|tree-sitter\\|gnutls\\|imagemagick\\)" (symbol-name feature))
            (princ (format "  %s\n" feature))))
        (switch-to-buffer "*Emacs Build Info*")
        (view-mode)))

** Project.el
#+begin_src emacs-lisp
  (use-package project
    :ensure nil
    :config
    (setq project-list-file (expand-file-name "projects" user-emacs-directory))
    (setq project-vc-extra-root-markers '(".project" ".git"))

    ;; Project type detection (gradle/maven/npm/rust/python)
    (defun my/project-type (dir)
      "Return the project type symbol for DIR."
      (cond
       ((or (file-exists-p (expand-file-name "build.gradle" dir))
            (file-exists-p (expand-file-name "build.gradle.kts" dir))) 'gradle)
       ((file-exists-p (expand-file-name "pom.xml" dir)) 'maven)
       ((file-exists-p (expand-file-name "package.json" dir)) 'npm)
       ((file-exists-p (expand-file-name "Cargo.toml" dir)) 'rust)
       ((or (file-exists-p (expand-file-name "pyproject.toml" dir))
            (file-exists-p (expand-file-name "setup.py" dir))
            (file-exists-p (expand-file-name "requirements.txt" dir))) 'python)
       (t nil)))

    ;; Fallback marker detection (appended so git backend runs first)
    (defun my/project-try-local (dir)
      "Detect project root by common build/config file markers."
      (catch 'found
        (let ((home (expand-file-name "~")))
          (dolist (file '("Gemfile" "package.json" "Cargo.toml" "go.mod"
                          "pom.xml" "build.gradle" "build.gradle.kts" "settings.gradle"
                          "pyproject.toml" "setup.py" "Makefile" "CMakeLists.txt"
                          "meson.build" "project.clj" "deps.edn" "mix.exs"))
            (let ((path (locate-dominating-file dir file)))
              (when (and path (not (file-equal-p path home)))
                (throw 'found (cons 'transient path))))))))
    (add-hook 'project-find-functions 'my/project-try-local 100)

    ;; Smart find-file: falls back to plain find-file outside a project
    (defun my/project-find-file ()
      "Find file in project, or fall back to regular find-file."
      (interactive)
      (if (project-current)
          (project-find-file)
        (call-interactively 'find-file)))

    ;; Project-scoped recent files via recentf
    (defun my/project-recent-files ()
      "Show recentf entries scoped to the current project root."
      (interactive)
      (let* ((project (project-current))
             (root (and project (project-root project)))
             (files (and root (seq-filter (lambda (f) (string-prefix-p root f)) recentf-list))))
        (if files
            (find-file (completing-read "Recent (project): " files))
          (message "No recent files in this project."))))

    ;; Type-aware compile / test / run
    (defun my/project-compile ()
      "Compile the current project using its detected build tool."
      (interactive)
      (let* ((root (project-root (project-current t)))
             (cmd (pcase (my/project-type root)
                    ('gradle "./gradlew build")
                    ('maven  "mvn compile")
                    ('npm    "npm run build")
                    ('rust   "cargo build")
                    ('python "black .")
                    (_       (read-string "Compile command: " "make -k ")))))
        (let ((default-directory root)) (compile cmd))))

    (defun my/project-test ()
      "Run tests for the current project."
      (interactive)
      (let* ((root (project-root (project-current t)))
             (cmd (pcase (my/project-type root)
                    ('gradle "./gradlew test")
                    ('maven  "mvn test")
                    ('npm    "npm test")
                    ('rust   "cargo test")
                    ('python "pytest")
                    (_       (read-string "Test command: " "make test ")))))
        (let ((default-directory root)) (compile cmd))))

    (defun my/project-run ()
      "Run the current project."
      (interactive)
      (let* ((root (project-root (project-current t)))
             (cmd (pcase (my/project-type root)
                    ('gradle "./gradlew run")
                    ('maven  "mvn exec:java")
                    ('npm    "npm start")
                    ('rust   "cargo run")
                    (_       (read-string "Run command: ")))))
        (let ((default-directory root)) (compile cmd)))))

** Vanilla Keymap Setup
To mimic Doom's leader keys (~SPC~), we use native Emacs 30+ keymaps and ~which-key~.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp
  (defvar my-leader-map (make-sparse-keymap)
    "Keymap for my leader bindings.")

  ;; Define a helper function to bind keys in our leader map
  (defun my/bind-leader (key command &optional description)
    "Bind KEY to COMMAND in `my-leader-map` with DESCRIPTION."
    (keymap-set my-leader-map key
                (if description
                    `(menu-item ,description ,command)
                  command)))

  ;; Bind the leader map to SPC in Evil states
  (with-eval-after-load 'evil
    (keymap-set evil-normal-state-map "SPC" my-leader-map)
    (keymap-set evil-visual-state-map "SPC" my-leader-map)
    (keymap-set evil-motion-state-map "SPC" my-leader-map))

  ;; Bind to M-SPC globally
  (keymap-global-set "M-SPC" my-leader-map)

  ;; Add prefix labels for which-key
  (with-eval-after-load 'which-key
    (which-key-add-keymap-based-replacements my-leader-map
      "h"   "help/config"
      "b"   "buffer"
      "c"   "code"

* Async Command Runner
A general-purpose async command runner with smart completion.
Detects mise tasks, npm scripts, Makefile targets, Gradle tasks, and Docker Compose commands
from the current project, and feeds them into the Corfu/Cape completion stack.
** Command Collectors
#+begin_src emacs-lisp
  (defvar my/run-history nil
    "History of shell commands run via my/run.")

  (defvar my/run-favorites
    '("mise run" "docker compose up -d" "docker compose down"
      "podman compose up -d" "podman compose down"
      "npm start" "npm test" "npm run build"
      "pytest" "python -m pytest"
      "cargo build" "cargo run" "cargo test"
      "make" "make test" "make clean")
    "Global favorite commands always shown in completion.")

  (defun my/run--mise-tasks ()
    "Return list of 'mise run TASK' strings from current project."
    (let ((default-directory (or (and (project-current)
                                      (project-root (project-current)))
                                 default-directory)))
      (condition-case nil
          (let ((output (shell-command-to-string "mise tasks --json 2>/dev/null")))
            (unless (string-empty-p output)
              (let* ((json-array-type 'list)
                     (json-object-type 'alist)
                     (parsed (json-read-from-string output)))
                (mapcar (lambda (task)
                          (let ((name (alist-get 'name task))
                                (desc (or (alist-get 'description task) "")))
                            (propertize (format "mise run %s" name)
                                       'my/annotation desc)))
                        parsed))))
        (error nil))))

  (defun my/run--package-json-scripts ()
    "Return list of 'npm run SCRIPT' strings from package.json."
    (let* ((root (or (and (project-current) (project-root (project-current)))
                     default-directory))
           (pkg (expand-file-name "package.json" root)))
      (when (file-exists-p pkg)
        (condition-case nil
            (let* ((json-object-type 'alist)
                   (json-array-type 'list)
                   (data (json-read-file pkg))
                   (scripts (alist-get 'scripts data)))
              (mapcar (lambda (s)
                        (propertize (format "npm run %s" (car s))
                                    'my/annotation (cdr s)))
                      scripts))
          (error nil)))))

  (defun my/run--makefile-targets ()
    "Return list of 'make TARGET' strings from Makefile."
    (let* ((root (or (and (project-current) (project-root (project-current)))
                     default-directory))
           (makefile (expand-file-name "Makefile" root)))
      (when (file-exists-p makefile)
        (condition-case nil
            (let ((output (shell-command-to-string
                           (format "make -pRrq -f %s : 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/^[a-zA-Z0-9][^$#\\/\\t=]*:([^=]|$)/ {split($1,A,/ /);print A[1]}' | sort -u"
                                   (shell-quote-argument makefile)))))
              (mapcar (lambda (target) (format "make %s" target))
                      (split-string output "\n" t)))
          (error nil)))))

  (defun my/run--gradle-tasks ()
    "Return common Gradle tasks if gradlew exists."
    (let* ((root (or (and (project-current) (project-root (project-current)))
                     default-directory))
           (gradlew (expand-file-name "gradlew" root)))
      (when (file-exists-p gradlew)
        (mapcar (lambda (task) (format "./gradlew %s" task))
                '("build" "test" "run" "clean" "bootRun"
                  "assemble" "check" "classes" "jar")))))

  (defun my/run--docker-compose-services ()
    "Return docker compose commands if a compose file exists."
    (let* ((root (or (and (project-current) (project-root (project-current)))
                     default-directory))
           (compose-cmd (if (executable-find "podman") "podman compose" "docker compose")))
      (when (or (file-exists-p (expand-file-name "docker-compose.yml" root))
                (file-exists-p (expand-file-name "docker-compose.yaml" root))
                (file-exists-p (expand-file-name "compose.yml" root))
                (file-exists-p (expand-file-name "compose.yaml" root))
                (seq-some (lambda (f) (string-match-p "docker-compose" f))
                          (directory-files root nil "\\.ya?ml$")))
        (mapcar (lambda (sub) (format "%s %s" compose-cmd sub))
                '("up -d" "down" "logs -f" "ps" "build" "restart" "pull")))))

  (defun my/run--collect-candidates ()
    "Collect all command candidates for the current project."
    (let ((all (append (my/run--mise-tasks)
                       (my/run--package-json-scripts)
                       (my/run--makefile-targets)
                       (my/run--gradle-tasks)
                       (my/run--docker-compose-services)
                       my/run-favorites
                       my/run-history)))
      (cl-remove-duplicates (seq-filter #'stringp all)
                            :test (lambda (a b) (string= a b))
                            :from-end t)))

  (defun my/run--annotate (cand)
    "Annotation function for run candidates."
    (if-let ((ann (get-text-property 0 'my/annotation cand)))
        (format "  %s" (propertize ann 'face 'marginalia-documentation))
      ""))
#+end_src

** Runner Commands
#+begin_src emacs-lisp
  (defun my/run (cmd)
    "Run CMD asynchronously from project root, with smart completion."
    (interactive
     (let ((minibuffer-completing-file-name nil))
       (list (completing-read
              "Run: "
              (lambda (str pred action)
                (if (eq action 'metadata)
                    '(metadata (annotation-function . my/run--annotate)
                               (category . my/run-command))
                  (complete-with-action action (my/run--collect-candidates) str pred)))
              nil nil nil 'my/run-history))))
    (let* ((default-directory (or (and (project-current)
                                       (project-root (project-current)))
                                  default-directory))
           (short (car (split-string cmd)))
           (buf-name (format "*run:%s*" short)))
      (async-shell-command cmd buf-name)
      (message "Started: %s" cmd)))

  (defun my/run-compile (cmd)
    "Run CMD in a compilation buffer with smart completion."
    (interactive
     (list (completing-read
            "Compile: "
            (lambda (str pred action)
              (if (eq action 'metadata)
                  '(metadata (annotation-function . my/run--annotate)
                             (category . my/run-command))
                (complete-with-action action (my/run--collect-candidates) str pred)))
            nil nil nil 'my/run-history)))
    (let ((default-directory (or (and (project-current)
                                       (project-root (project-current)))
                                  default-directory)))
      (compile cmd)))

  (defun my/run-stop ()
    "Stop a running async command."
    (interactive)
    (let* ((bufs (seq-filter (lambda (b)
                               (and (string-prefix-p "*run:" (buffer-name b))
                                    (get-buffer-process b)))
                             (buffer-list)))
           (names (mapcar #'buffer-name bufs)))
      (if (null names)
          (message "No running commands")
        (let* ((choice (completing-read "Stop: " names nil t))
               (proc (get-buffer-process (get-buffer choice))))
          (when proc
            (interrupt-process proc)
            (sit-for 0.3)
            (when (process-live-p proc) (kill-process proc)))
          (message "Stopped %s" choice)))))

  (defun my/run-show ()
    "Switch to a running command buffer."
    (interactive)
    (let* ((bufs (seq-filter (lambda (b)
                               (string-prefix-p "*run:" (buffer-name b)))
                             (buffer-list)))
           (names (mapcar #'buffer-name bufs)))
      (if (null names)
          (message "No command buffers")
        (switch-to-buffer (completing-read "Show: " names nil t)))))

  (defun my/run-restart ()
    "Restart the last command from history."
    (interactive)
    (if my/run-history
        (my/run (car my/run-history))
      (call-interactively #'my/run)))
#+end_src

** Cape Integration (In-Buffer Completion)
Provides Corfu popup suggestions for shell commands in eshell, shell-mode,
comint, eat, vterm, and agent-shell buffers.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp
  (defvar my/cape-run-cache nil
    "Cached candidates as (PROJECT-ROOT . CANDIDATES).")

  (defun my/cape-run--invalidate-cache ()
    "Clear cache when switching projects."
    (setq my/cape-run-cache nil))

  (advice-add 'project-switch-project :after
              (lambda (&rest _) (my/cape-run--invalidate-cache)))

  (defun my/cape-run--candidates ()
    "Return cached or fresh command candidates for the current project."
    (let ((root (or (and (project-current) (project-root (project-current)))
                    default-directory)))
      (if (and my/cape-run-cache (string= (car my/cape-run-cache) root))
          (cdr my/cape-run-cache)
        (let ((cands (my/run--collect-candidates)))
          (setq my/cape-run-cache (cons root cands))
          cands))))

  (defun my/cape-run-capf ()
    "Completion-at-point function for shell commands.
  Completes from BOL or after &&, ||, |, ; separators."
    (let* ((line-start (line-beginning-position))
           (pt (point))
           (text (buffer-substring-no-properties line-start pt))
           ;; Find where the current command starts (after pipe, &&, ;, etc.)
           (cmd-start (if (string-match ".*\\(?:[;&|][ \t]*\\)" text)
                          (+ line-start (match-end 0))
                        line-start))
           (prefix (buffer-substring-no-properties cmd-start pt)))
      (when (>= (length prefix) 1)
        (list cmd-start pt
              (completion-table-dynamic
               (lambda (_) (my/cape-run--candidates)))
              :annotation-function #'my/run--annotate
              :exclusive 'no))))

  ;; Hook into shell/terminal modes (low priority so LSP/native CAPFs win)
  (dolist (hook '(eshell-mode-hook
                  shell-mode-hook
                  comint-mode-hook
                  eat-mode-hook
                  vterm-mode-hook
                  agent-shell-mode-hook))
    (add-hook hook
              (lambda ()
                (add-hook 'completion-at-point-functions
                          #'my/cape-run-capf -50 t))))

  ;; Also provide completion in M-x shell-command, compile, and my/run prompts
  (add-hook 'minibuffer-setup-hook
            (lambda ()
              (when (memq this-command
                          '(async-shell-command shell-command compile
                            my/run my/run-compile))
                (add-hook 'completion-at-point-functions
                          #'my/cape-run-capf -50 t))))

  ;; Merged shell super-CAPF: project commands + files + history + dabbrev
  ;; This replaces the default CAPFs in shell buffers with a combined source.
  (defun my/cape-shell-super-capf ()
    "Combined CAPF: project commands + file paths + history + dabbrev."
    (cape-wrap-super
     #'my/cape-run-capf
     #'cape-file
     #'cape-history
     #'cape-dabbrev))

  (dolist (hook '(eshell-mode-hook
                  shell-mode-hook
                  comint-mode-hook))
    (add-hook hook
              (lambda ()
                (setq-local completion-at-point-functions
                            (list #'my/cape-shell-super-capf)))))

* Window Management (Popups & Rules)
** Popup Windows (built-in toggle)
#+begin_src emacs-lisp
  (defvar my/popup-buffer-regexps
    '("\\*Messages\\*" "Output\\*$" "\\*Async Shell Command\\*"
      "\\*Help\\*" "\\*compilation\\*" "\\*Flymake diagnostics\\*" "\\*Warnings\\*"
      "\\*docker-compose\\*" "\\*docker-run\\*")
    "Regexps matching buffers treated as popups.")

  (defun my/popup-buffer-p (buf)
    "Return t if BUF matches a popup regexp or is derived from a popup mode."
    (let ((name (buffer-name buf)))
      (or (seq-some (lambda (re) (string-match-p re name)) my/popup-buffer-regexps)
          (with-current-buffer buf
            (derived-mode-p 'help-mode 'compilation-mode)))))

  (defun my/popup-toggle ()
    "Hide any visible popup, or show the most recent one."
    (interactive)
    (let ((popup-win (seq-find (lambda (w) (my/popup-buffer-p (window-buffer w)))
                               (window-list))))
      (if popup-win
          (delete-window popup-win)
        (when-let ((buf (seq-find #'my/popup-buffer-p (buffer-list))))
          (display-buffer buf)))))

  (defun my/popup-cycle ()
    "Cycle through popup buffers."
    (interactive)
    (let* ((popups (seq-filter #'my/popup-buffer-p (buffer-list)))
           (current (and (my/popup-buffer-p (current-buffer)) (current-buffer)))
           (next (if current
                     (or (cadr (member current popups)) (car popups))
                   (car popups))))
      (when next (display-buffer next))))

  (global-set-key (kbd "C-`")   #'my/popup-toggle)
  (global-set-key (kbd "M-`")   #'my/popup-cycle)
#+end_src

  ;; jk escape from insert mode (no package needed)
  (defun my/evil-escape-jk ()
    "Escape from insert mode with 'jk'."
    (interactive)
    (let ((modified (buffer-modified-p)))
      (insert "j")
      (let ((next-char (read-event nil nil 0.15)))
        (if (equal next-char ?k)
            (progn
              (delete-char -1)
              (set-buffer-modified-p modified)
              (evil-normal-state))
          (setq unread-command-events (list next-char))))))

** Undo System
 We use a combination of three packages for the supreme undo experience:
 1. ~undo-fu~: Simple linear wrapper for Emacs' undo system (required for Evil).
 2. ~undo-fu-session~: Saves undo history to disk (persistence across restarts).

#+begin_src emacs-lisp
  (use-package vertico
    :demand t
    :init
    (vertico-mode)
    (vertico-multiform-mode)
    :custom (vertico-cycle t)
    :bind (:map vertico-map
                ("C-j" . vertico-next)
                ("C-k" . vertico-previous)
                ("C-f" . vertico-scroll-down)
                ("C-b" . vertico-scroll-up)))

  (use-package savehist
    :ensure nil
    :init (savehist-mode))

  (use-package orderless
    :ensure t
    :custom
    (completion-styles '(orderless basic))
    (completion-category-overrides '((file (styles basic partial-completion))))
    :config
    (defun my/orderless-dispatch (pattern _index _total)
      (cond
       ;; Standard dispatchers
       ((string-prefix-p "!" pattern) `(orderless-without-literal . ,(substring pattern 1)))
       ((string-suffix-p "=" pattern) `(orderless-literal . ,(substring pattern 0 -1)))
       ((string-prefix-p "," pattern) `(orderless-initialism . ,(substring pattern 1)))
       ((string-suffix-p "~" pattern) `(orderless-flex . ,(substring pattern 0 -1)))
       ;; New: Anchor dispatchers
       ((string-prefix-p "^" pattern) `(orderless-regexp . ,(concat "^" (substring pattern 1))))
       ((string-suffix-p "$" pattern) `(orderless-regexp . ,(concat (substring pattern 0 -1) "$")))))
    (setq orderless-style-dispatchers '(my/orderless-dispatch)))

  (use-package marginalia
    :ensure t
    :after vertico
    :custom
    (marginalia-max-relative-age 0)
    (marginalia-align 'right)
    :init (marginalia-mode)
    :bind (:map minibuffer-local-map ("M-A" . marginalia-cycle))
    :config
    ;; Custom simplified annotator for Buffers
    (defun my/marginalia-annotate-buffer (cand)
      (when-let (buffer (get-buffer cand))
        (let* ((file (buffer-file-name buffer))
               (type (cond (file "File")
                           ((derived-mode-p 'dired-mode) "Dir")
                           (t "Buf")))
               ;; Get path relative to project or home
               (path (if file
                         (if-let ((project (project-current nil (file-name-directory file))))
                             (file-relative-name file (project-root project))
                           (abbreviate-file-name file))
                       "")))
          (marginalia--fields
           (type :width 5 :face 'marginalia-type)
           (path :face 'marginalia-file-name)))))

    ;; Custom simplified annotator for Files (Recentf)
    (defun my/marginalia-annotate-file (cand)
      (let* ((path (if-let ((project (project-current nil (file-name-directory cand))))
                       (file-relative-name cand (project-root project))
                     (abbreviate-file-name cand))))
        (marginalia--fields
         ("File" :width 5 :face 'marginalia-type)
         (path :face 'marginalia-file-name))))

    ;; Register the custom annotators safely
    (with-eval-after-load 'marginalia
      (setq marginalia-annotator-alist
            (append '((buffer . my/marginalia-annotate-buffer)
                      (file . my/marginalia-annotate-file))
                    (bound-and-true-p marginalia-annotator-alist)))))

  (use-package nerd-icons-completion
    :after marginalia
    :config
    (nerd-icons-completion-mode)
    (add-hook 'marginalia-mode-hook #'nerd-icons-completion-marginalia-setup))

      ;; --- 2. Smart Path Guessing Improvements ---
      (require 'ffap)
      ;; Recognize more file-like patterns for ffap
      (dolist (pair '((git-truename "\\([-[:alnum:]_.$=/:]+\\)")
                      (yaml-key . "\\(?1:[[:alnum:]_-]+[[:space:]]*:\\)")
                      (docker-image . "\\(?:[a-z0-9._-]+/\\)?[a-z0-9._-]+:[a-z0-9._-]+")))
        (add-to-list 'ffap-string-at-point-mode-alist pair))

      ;; Make embark guess file paths more aggressively
      (defvar my/embark-extra-file-actions
        '(("P" . (lambda (f) (with-current-buffer (find-file-noselect f) (pop-to-buffer))))
          ("D" . dired)
          ("X" . executable-make-absolute-file-local-name))
        "Additional file actions for embark.")

      ;; Enhance the file map with extra actions
      (dolist (action my/embark-extra-file-actions)
        (define-key embark-file-map (car action) (cdr action)))

      ;; --- 3. Org-Specific Targets (Links, Timestamps, Dates) ---
      (defun my/embark-target-org-link ()
        "Detect Org mode links."
        (when (and (eq major-mode 'org-mode)
                   (org-in-regexp org-link-any-re 1))
          (let* ((start (match-beginning 1))
                 (end (match-end 1))
                 (link (org-link-unescape (match-string 1))))
            (when link
              (cons 'org-link link)))))

      (defun my/embark-target-org-timestamp ()
        "Detect Org timestamps."
        (when (and (eq major-mode 'org-mode)
                   (org-in-regexp org-ts-regexp-both 1))
          (let ((start (match-beginning 1))
                (end (match-end 1)))
            (cons 'org-timestamp (match-string 1)))))

      (defun my/embark-target-org-deadline ()
        "Detect Org deadline timestamps."
        (when (and (eq major-mode 'org-mode)
                   (org-in-regexp org-deadline-re 1))
          (let ((start (match-beginning 1))
                (end (match-end 1)))
            (cons 'org-deadline (match-string 1)))))

      (defun my/embark-target-org-schedule ()
        "Detect Org scheduled timestamps."
        (when (and (eq major-mode 'org-mode)
                   (org-in-regexp org-scheduled-re 1))
          (let ((start (match-beginning 1))
                (end (match-end 1)))
            (cons 'org-schedule (match-string 1)))))

      ;; Add Org target finders
      (add-to-list 'embark-target-finders #'my/embark-target-org-link)
      (add-to-list 'embark-target-finders #'my/embark-target-org-timestamp)
      (add-to-list 'embark-target-finders #'my/embark-target-org-deadline)
      (add-to-list 'embark-target-finders #'my/embark-target-org-schedule)

      ;; Define Org-specific action keymaps
      (defvar-keymap my/embark-org-link-map
        :doc "Keymap for Org link actions."
        :parent embark-general-map
        "RET" #'org-open-at-point
        "o" #'org-open-at-point
        "f" #'org-link-open-if-in-browser
        "c" #'org-copy-link
        "k" #'org-kill-link
        "e" #'org-edit-link)

      (defvar-keymap my/embark-org-timestamp-map
        :doc "Keymap for Org timestamp actions."
        :parent embark-general-map
        "RET" #'org-time-stamp
        "c" #'org-clone-subtree-with-time-shift
        "+" #'org-timestamp-up
        "-" #'org-timestamp-down
        "s" #'org-schedule)

      ;; Register Org action maps
      (setq embark-keymap-alist
            (append
             '((org-link . my/embark-org-link-map)
               (org-timestamp . my/embark-org-timestamp-map)
               (org-deadline . my/embark-org-timestamp-map)
               (org-schedule . my/embark-org-timestamp-map))
             embark-keymap-alist)))

    (use-package embark-consult
      :ensure t
      :after (embark consult))
#+end_src

#+begin_src emacs-lisp :tangle yes
  (use-package cape
    :ensure t
    :init
    ;; Wrap comint and pcomplete for better shell/REPL completion
    (advice-add #'comint-completion-at-point :around #'cape-wrap-nonexclusive)
    (advice-add #'pcomplete-completions-at-point :around #'cape-wrap-nonexclusive)

    ;; Add CAPFs buffer-locally with proper ordering (higher = higher priority)
    ;; File completion in prog modes (depth -10 = lower priority than LSP)
    (add-hook 'prog-mode-hook
              (lambda () (add-hook 'completion-at-point-functions #'cape-file -10 t)))

    ;; Dabbrev as fallback in most buffers (depth 20 = low priority fallback)
    (dolist (hook '(prog-mode-hook text-mode-hook conf-mode-hook comint-mode-hook))
      (add-hook hook (lambda () (add-hook 'completion-at-point-functions #'cape-dabbrev 20 t))))

    ;; Elisp blocks in org/markdown
    (add-hook 'org-mode-hook
              (lambda () (add-hook 'completion-at-point-functions #'cape-elisp-block 0 t)))
    (add-hook 'markdown-mode-hook
              (lambda () (add-hook 'completion-at-point-functions #'cape-elisp-block 0 t)))

    :config
    (setq pcomplete-ignore-case t)
    (setq cape-dabbrev-check-other-buffers t))

  (defun my/spell-toggle-lang ()
    "Toggle between English and Brazilian Portuguese for Jinx and Cape."
    (interactive)
    (if (string-match-p "en_US" (or (getenv "DICTIONARY") ""))
        (setenv "DICTIONARY" "pt_BR")

    (when (fboundp 'jinx-languages)

          (jinx-languages "en_US")
        (jinx-languages "pt_BR en_US")))

#+begin_src emacs-lisp
  ;; === Java File & Class Creation (IntelliJ-style) ===

  (defun my/java-source-root ()
    "Find the Java source root (src/main/java or src/test/java)."
    (let* ((file (or (buffer-file-name) default-directory))
           (root (project-root (project-current t))))
      (catch 'found
        (dolist (dir '("src/main/java/" "src/test/java/" "src/"))
          (let ((full (expand-file-name dir root)))
            (when (and (file-directory-p full)
                       (string-prefix-p full file))
              (throw 'found full))))
        (expand-file-name "src/main/java/" root))))

  (defun my/java-current-package ()
    "Infer package from current file or directory relative to source root."
    (let* ((src-root (my/java-source-root))
           (current (or (and (buffer-file-name) (file-name-directory (buffer-file-name)))
                        default-directory))
           (relative (file-relative-name current src-root)))
      (if (or (string= relative "./") (string= relative "."))
          ""
        (replace-regexp-in-string "/" "." (directory-file-name relative)))))

  (defun my/java-create-class (fqcn kind)
    "Create a Java file for FQCN (e.g. com.foo.MyClass) of KIND."
    (let* ((parts (split-string fqcn "\\."))
           (class-name (car (last parts)))
           (package (mapconcat #'identity (butlast parts) "."))
           (src-root (my/java-source-root))
           (dir (expand-file-name (replace-regexp-in-string "\\." "/" (if (string-empty-p package) "" package)) src-root))
           (file (expand-file-name (concat class-name ".java") dir))
           (body (pcase kind
                   ('class      (format "public class %s {\n\n}" class-name))
                   ('interface  (format "public interface %s {\n\n}" class-name))
                   ('enum       (format "public enum %s {\n    ;\n}" class-name))
                   ('record     (format "public record %s() {\n}" class-name))
                   ('annotation (format "public @interface %s {\n\n}" class-name))
                   (_           (format "public class %s {\n\n}" class-name))))
           (content (if (string-empty-p package)
                        (concat body "\n")
                      (concat (format "package %s;\n\n%s\n" package body)))))
      (when (file-exists-p file)
        (user-error "File already exists: %s" file))
      (make-directory dir t)
      (find-file file)
      (insert content)
      (save-buffer)
      (goto-char (point-min))
      (search-forward "{" nil t)
      (forward-line 0)
      (open-line 1)
      (indent-for-tab-command)
      (message "Created %s %s" kind fqcn)))

  (defun my/java-new-class ()
    "Create a new Java class."
    (interactive)
    (let* ((pkg (my/java-current-package))
           (default (if (string-empty-p pkg) "" (concat pkg ".")))
           (fqcn (read-string "Class (e.g. com.foo.MyClass): " default)))
      (my/java-create-class fqcn 'class)))

  (defun my/java-new-interface ()
    "Create a new Java interface."
    (interactive)
    (let* ((pkg (my/java-current-package))
           (default (if (string-empty-p pkg) "" (concat pkg ".")))
           (fqcn (read-string "Interface: " default)))
      (my/java-create-class fqcn 'interface)))

  (defun my/java-new-enum ()
    "Create a new Java enum."
    (interactive)
    (let* ((pkg (my/java-current-package))
           (default (if (string-empty-p pkg) "" (concat pkg ".")))
           (fqcn (read-string "Enum: " default)))
      (my/java-create-class fqcn 'enum)))

  (defun my/java-new-record ()
    "Create a new Java record."
    (interactive)
    (let* ((pkg (my/java-current-package))
           (default (if (string-empty-p pkg) "" (concat pkg ".")))
           (fqcn (read-string "Record: " default)))
      (my/java-create-class fqcn 'record)))

  (defun my/java-new-file ()
    "Create a new Java file, choosing the kind interactively (IntelliJ-style)."
    (interactive)
    (let* ((kind (intern (completing-read "Kind: " '("class" "interface" "enum" "record" "annotation") nil t)))
           (pkg (my/java-current-package))
           (default (if (string-empty-p pkg) "" (concat pkg ".")))
           (fqcn (read-string (format "New %s: " kind) default)))
      (my/java-create-class fqcn kind)))

  (defun my/java-go-to-test ()
    "Jump between source and test file (convention-based)."
    (interactive)
    (unless (buffer-file-name)
      (user-error "Not visiting a file"))
    (let* ((file (buffer-file-name))
           (root (project-root (project-current t)))
           (is-test (string-match-p "/src/test/" file)))
      (let ((target (if is-test
                        (replace-regexp-in-string "/src/test/" "/src/main/"
                          (replace-regexp-in-string "Test\\.java$" ".java" file))
                      (replace-regexp-in-string "/src/main/" "/src/test/"
                        (replace-regexp-in-string "\\.java$" "Test.java" file)))))
        (if (file-exists-p target)
            (find-file target)
          (when (y-or-n-p (format "Create %s?" (file-name-nondirectory target)))
            (make-directory (file-name-directory target) t)
            (find-file target)
            (let* ((rel (file-relative-name target (if is-test
                                                       (expand-file-name "src/main/java/" root)
                                                     (expand-file-name "src/test/java/" root))))
                   (parts (split-string (file-name-sans-extension rel) "/"))
                   (class-name (car (last parts)))
                   (pkg (mapconcat #'identity (butlast parts) ".")))
              (insert (format "package %s;\n\nimport org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;\n\nclass %s {\n\n    @Test\n    void shouldWork() {\n    }\n}\n" pkg class-name))
              (save-buffer)))))))
#+end_src

** Linting (Flymake)
 Configured for Eglot and Consult integration. Replaces Flycheck for consistency.
 #+begin_src emacs-lisp
  ;; Simple flymake configuration - avoid eval-after-load to prevent macro expansion errors
  (add-hook 'prog-mode-hook #'flymake-mode)

  ;; Configure flymake when loaded
  (eval-after-load 'flymake
    '(progn
       (setq flymake-fringe-indicator-position 'left-fringe)

        ;; 1. Window Configuration (Clean Popup at Bottom)
       (add-to-list 'display-buffer-alist
                    '("\*Flymake diagnostics.*"
                      (display-buffer-reuse-window display-buffer-in-side-window)
                      (side . bottom)
                      (slot . 0)
                      (window-height . 0.25)
                      (preserve-size . (nil . t))
                      (window-parameters . ((no-other-window . nil)
                                            (mode-line-format . none)))))

        ;; 2. Diagnostics buffer visuals
       (add-hook 'flymake-project-diagnostics-mode-hook
                 (lambda ()
                   (setq header-line-format nil)
                   (setq tabulated-list-use-header-line nil)
                   (setq tabulated-list-gui-sort-indicator-mode nil)
                   (display-line-numbers-mode 0)
                   (hl-line-mode 1)))))

   ;; 3. Search function for Consult (simplified to avoid macro expansion issues)
    (defun my/consult-flymake-project ()
      "Search project errors via Consult, extracting data from Flymake."
      (interactive)
      (flymake-show-project-diagnostics)
      (let ((diag-buffer (get-buffer "*Flymake diagnostics*")))
        (if (not diag-buffer)
            (message "Please wait... Eglot is still indexing errors.")
          (with-current-buffer diag-buffer
            (let ((entries-raw (if (functionp tabulated-list-entries)
                                   (funcall tabulated-list-entries)
                                 tabulated-list-entries))
                  candidates)
              (dolist (entry entries-raw)
                (let* ((diag (car entry))
                       (buffer (flymake-diagnostic-buffer diag)))
                  (when (buffer-live-p buffer)
                    (let* ((line (line-number-at-pos (flymake-diagnostic-beg diag)))
                           (type (flymake-diagnostic-type diag))
                           (text (flymake-diagnostic-text diag))
                           (file (buffer-name buffer))
                           (face (flymake-diagnostic-type-face type))
                           (type-str (propertize (symbol-name type) 'face face))
                           (cand-str (format "%-20s %-8s %s"
                                             (propertize file 'face 'font-lock-variable-name-face)
                                             type-str
                                             (propertize text 'face 'shadow))))
                      (push (propertize cand-str
                                        'consult--candidate
                                        (cons (set-marker (make-marker) (flymake-diagnostic-beg diag)) buffer))
                            candidates)))))
              (if candidates
                  (consult--read (nreverse candidates)
                                 :prompt "Project Issues: "
                                 :category 'consult-location
                                 :sort nil
                                 :lookup #'consult--lookup-candidate)
                (message "No errors found in project.")))))))

   #+end_src

** Mise TOML with Embedded Language Support
  Enables syntax highlighting and LSP for embedded languages (bash, python, etc.) in mise `run` commands.

  #+begin_src emacs-lisp
  ;; Add TOML and Bash grammars for mise file support
  (with-eval-after-load 'treesit
    (add-to-list 'treesit-language-source-alist
                 '(toml "https://github.com/ikatyang/tree-sitter-toml"))
    (add-to-list 'treesit-language-source-alist
                 '(bash "https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-bash")))

  ;; Use toml-ts-mode for TOML files
  (add-to-list 'auto-mode-alist '("\\.toml\\'" . toml-ts-mode))
  (add-to-list 'auto-mode-alist ' ("\\.mise\\.toml\\'" . toml-ts-mode))
  (add-to-list 'auto-mode-alist '("\\.config/mise/.*\\.toml\\'" . toml-ts-mode))

  ;; Injection queries for embedded languages in TOML run commands
  ;; This enables syntax highlighting inside multi-line strings for run commands
  (defun my/setup-toml-injections ()
    "Set up treesit injection queries for embedded languages in TOML."
    (when (and (treesit-ready-p 'toml) (treesit-ready-p 'bash))
      (let ((query "(pair
  (bare_key) @key (#eq? @key \"run\")
  (string) @injection.content
  (#match? @injection.content \"^['\\\"]{3}.*\")
  (#offset! @injection.content 0 3 0 -3)
  (#set! injection.language \"bash\"))"))
        (treesit-query-set 'toml 'embedded query))))

  ;; Alternative: Manual injection via font-lock for run commands
  (defun my/mise-run-fontify (beg end)
    "Fontify embedded code in mise run commands between BEG and END."
    (when (and (treesit-ready-p 'bash)
               (string-match-p "mise.*\\.toml\\'" (or buffer-file-name "")))
      (save-excursion
        (goto-char beg)
        (while (re-search-forward "^run\\s-*=\\s-*\"\"\"\\(?:#!\\([^\"\n]+\\)\\)?" end t)
          (let ((lang-start (match-beginning 0))
                (lang (match-string 1))
                (code-start (match-end 0)))
            (goto-char code-start)
            (when (re-search-forward "\"\"\"" nil t)
              (let ((code-end (match-beginning 0)))
                (when-let* ((lang-name (cond ((string-match-p "python" (or lang "")) "python")
                                             ((string-match-p "bash\\|sh" (or lang "")) "bash")
                                             ((string-match-p "node" (or lang "")) "javascript")
                                             (t "bash")))
                            (lang-mode (intern (format "%s-ts-mode" lang-name))))
                (when (functionp lang-mode)
                  (treesit-fontify-region code-start code-end lang-name))))))))))

  ;; Indirect buffer method for full LSP support on embedded code
  (defun my/mise-edit-run-command ()
    "Edit the run command at point in an indirect buffer with proper LSP.
  Opens an indirect buffer with the embedded code, enabling full LSP features."
    (interactive)
    (let* ((line-content (buffer-substring-no-properties (line-beginning-position) (line-end-position)))
           (in-string (and (string-match "^run\\s-*=\\s-*\"\"\"\\(?:#!\\([^\"\n]+\\)\\)?" line-content)
                           (or (match-string 1 line-content) "/bin/bash"))))
      (goto-char (line-beginning-position))
      (if (re-search-forward "^run\\s-*=\\s-*\"\"\"\\(?:#!\\([^\"\n]+\\)\\)?" (line-end-position) t)
          (let* ((shebang (or (match-string 1) "/bin/bash"))
                 (lang (cond ((string-match-p "python" shebang) "python")
                             ((string-match-p "bash\\|sh" shebang) "bash")
                             ((string-match-p "node" shebang) "javascript")
                             (t "bash")))
                 (code-start (match-end 0))
                 (code-end (save-excursion
                             (goto-char code-start)
                             (if (re-search-forward "\"\"\"" nil t)
                                 (match-beginning 0)
                               (point-max))))
                 (code (buffer-substring-no-properties code-start code-end))
                 (buf-name (format "*mise-run:%s*" (file-name-nondirectory (buffer-file-name))))
                 (mode (intern (format "%s-ts-mode" lang))))
            (with-current-buffer (get-buffer-create buf-name)
              (erase-buffer)
              (insert code)
              (when (functionp mode) (funcall mode))
              (setq-local my/mise-source-buffer (current-buffer))
              (setq-local my/mise-source-start code-start)
              (setq-local my/mise-source-end code-end)
              (goto-char (point-min)))
            (pop-to-buffer buf-name)
            (message "Edit the command, then C-c C-c to save back to source"))
        (user-error "Not on a run command with multi-line string"))))

  (defun my/mise-save-back ()
    "Save edited content back to the source mise file."
    (interactive)
    (if (and (boundp 'my/mise-source-buffer)
             (buffer-live-p my/mise-source-buffer))
        (let ((content (buffer-string)))
          (with-current-buffer my/mise-source-buffer
            (goto-char my/mise-source-start)
            (delete-region my/mise-source-start my/mise-source-end)
            (insert content))
          (kill-buffer))
      (user-error "Not in a mise edit buffer")))

  (with-eval-after-load 'toml-ts-mode
    (define-key toml-ts-mode-map (kbd "C-c C-e") #'my/mise-edit-run-command))
  #+end_src

       (agent-shell))

    (defun my-agent-shell-restart ()
      "Restart agent-shell with current model."
      (interactive)
      (let ((buffers (buffer-list)))
        (dolist (buf buffers)
          (when (string-match-p "\\*agent-shell" (buffer-name buf))
            (when (buffer-live-p buf)
              (let ((proc (get-buffer-process buf)))
                (when proc
                  (delete-process proc)))
              (kill-buffer buf))))
      (agent-shell))

     (defun my-agent-shell-status ()
       "Show current agent-shell configuration."
       (interactive)
       (message "Current Gemini model: %s | YOLO: %s | Command: %S"
                my-agent-shell-google-gemini-model
                my-agent-shell-use-yolo
                agent-shell-google-gemini-acp-command))

     ;; === Model Persistence ===
     (defconst my-agent-shell-model-file
       (expand-file-name "agent-shell-model" user-emacs-directory)
       "File to persist the selected Gemini model.")

     (defun my-agent-shell-save-model ()
       "Save the current model to disk."
       (with-temp-file my-agent-shell-model-file
         (insert my-agent-shell-google-gemini-model)))

     (defun my-agent-shell-load-model ()
       "Load the saved model from disk, if it exists."
       (when (file-exists-p my-agent-shell-model-file)
         (with-temp-buffer
           (insert-file-contents my-agent-shell-model-file)
           (let ((saved-model (string-trim (buffer-string))))
             (when (member saved-model my-agent-shell-google-gemini-models)
               (setq my-agent-shell-google-gemini-model saved-model)
               (my-agent-shell-google-update-gemini-command))))))

     (add-hook 'kill-emacs-hook 'my-agent-shell-save-model)

     ;; === Opencode Configuration ===
    (setq agent-shell-opencode-authentication
          (agent-shell-opencode-make-authentication :none t))

    (setq agent-shell-opencode-environment
           (agent-shell-make-environment-variables
            :inherit-env t))

    ;; === Keybindings ===
    ;; Main menu: M-x agent-shell (start/reuse agent)
    ;; Specific agents: M-x agent-shell-google-start-gemini
    ;;             M-x agent-shell-opencode-start-agent

    ;; === Evil Mode Integration ===
    (with-eval-after-load 'evil
      ;; Evil state-specific RET behavior: insert mode = newline, normal mode = send
      (evil-define-key 'insert agent-shell-mode-map (kbd "RET") #'newline)
      (evil-define-key 'normal agent-shell-mode-map (kbd "RET") #'comint-send-input)

      ;; Configure *agent-shell-diff* buffers to start in Emacs state
      (add-hook 'diff-mode-hook
                (lambda ()
                  (when (string-match-p "\\\\*agent-shell-diff\\\\\*" (buffer-name))
                    (evil-emacs-state)))))

    ;; === Display Configuration ===
    ;; Show welcome message
    (setq agent-shell-show-welcome-message t)

    ;; Show context usage indicator
    (setq agent-shell-show-context-usage-indicator t)

    ;; Show usage at turn end
    (setq agent-shell-show-usage-at-turn-end t)

     ;; Enable file completion
     (setq agent-shell-file-completion-enabled t)

     ;; === Initialize Model ===
     (my-agent-shell-load-model)
     (my-agent-shell-google-update-gemini-command)
     (setq agent-shell-preferred-agent-config (agent-shell-google-make-gemini-config))))
 #+end_src

** Java Test Coverage (JaCoCo)
Module for subtle coverage visualization.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp
  (defvar my/java-coverage-overlays nil "Global list of active overlays.")
  (defvar-local my/java-coverage-visible nil "Coverage state in the buffer.")

  (defface my/jacoco-lens-face
    '((t :inherit shadow :slant italic :height 0.9 :foreground "green"))
    "Face for the coverage percentage above methods.")

  (defface my/jacoco-missed-line-face
    '((t :underline (:style wave :color "orange")))
    "Subtle face (orange wave) for uncovered lines.")

  (defun my/java-get-jacoco-path ()
    "Locate the JaCoCo XML report via project.el."
    (let ((gradle-path "build/reports/jacoco/test/jacocoTestReport.xml")
          (maven-path "target/site/jacoco/jacocoTestReport.xml")
          (root (project-root (project-current))))
      (cond
       ((and root (file-exists-p (expand-file-name gradle-path root)))
        (expand-file-name gradle-path root))
       ((and root (file-exists-p (expand-file-name maven-path root)))
        (expand-file-name maven-path root))
       (t nil))))

  (defun my/java-coverage-browse-report ()
    "Open the JaCoCo HTML report in the browser."
    (interactive)
    (let ((gradle-html "build/reports/jacoco/test/html/index.html")
          (maven-html "target/site/jacoco/index.html")
          (root (project-root (project-current))))
      (cond
       ((and root (file-exists-p (expand-file-name gradle-html root)))
        (browse-url (expand-file-name gradle-html root)))
       ((and root (file-exists-p (expand-file-name maven-html root)))
        (browse-url (expand-file-name maven-html root)))
       (t (message "HTML report not found.")))))

  (defun my/java-coverage-clear ()
    "Remove all overlays and clear the list."
    (interactive)
    (when (boundp 'my/java-coverage-overlays)
      (mapc #'delete-overlay my/java-coverage-overlays)
      (setq my/java-coverage-overlays nil)))

  (defun my/java-coverage-toggle ()
    "Toggle the coverage visualization."
    (interactive)
    (if my/java-coverage-visible
        (progn
          (my/java-coverage-clear)
          (setq-local my/java-coverage-visible nil)
          (message "Coverage disabled."))
      (setq-local my/java-coverage-visible t)
      (my/java-apply-subtle-coverage)
      (message "Coverage enabled.")))

  (defun my/java-apply-subtle-coverage ()
    "Apply lenses to the signature and orange highlights with tooltips in the body."
    (let ((report-path (my/java-get-jacoco-path))
          (root (project-root (project-current))))
      (when (and report-path root)
        (let* ((relative-path (file-relative-name (buffer-file-name) root))
               (xml (xml-parse-file report-path))
               (report (car xml)))
          (my/java-coverage-clear)

          (dolist (pkg (xml-get-children report 'package))
            ;; 1. Signature Lenses
            (dolist (cls (xml-get-children pkg 'class))
              (when (string-suffix-p (concat (xml-get-attribute cls 'name) ".java") relative-path)
                (dolist (method (xml-get-children cls 'method))
                  (let* ((line-num (string-to-number (xml-get-attribute method 'line)))
                         (counters (xml-get-children method 'counter))
                         (line-c (seq-find (lambda (c) (string= (xml-get-attribute c 'type) "LINE")) counters))
                         (m (string-to-number (or (xml-get-attribute line-c 'missed) "0")))
                         (c (string-to-number (or (xml-get-attribute line-c 'covered) "0")))
                         (pct (if (> (+ m c) 0) (/ (* c 100) (+ m c)) 0))
                         (icon (if (= pct 100) (nerd-icons-faicon "nf-fa-check_circle" :face 'success) ""))
                         (text (format "%s Coverage: %d%%" icon pct)))
                    (my/java--create-lens-at-signature line-num text)))))

            ;; 2. Orange Highlights on missed lines with Tooltip
            (dolist (src (xml-get-children pkg 'sourcefile))
              (when (string-suffix-p (xml-get-attribute src 'name) relative-path)
                (dolist (line (xml-get-children src 'line))
                  (let ((missed (string-to-number (xml-get-attribute line 'mi)))
                        (covered (string-to-number (xml-get-attribute line 'ci)))
                        (line-num (string-to-number (xml-get-attribute line 'nr))))
                    (when (> missed 0)
                      (my/java--highlight-missed-line
                       line-num
                       (format "JaCoCo: Missed %s instructions (Covered: %s)" missed covered))))))))))))

  (defun my/java--create-lens-at-signature (line text)
    (save-excursion
      (goto-char (point-min))
      (forward-line (1- line))
      (while (and (> (line-number-at-pos) 1)
                  (looking-at "^[[:space:]]*\\(\{\\|$\\|@\\)"))
        (forward-line -1))
      (let ((ov (make-overlay (line-beginning-position) (line-beginning-position))))
        (overlay-put ov 'before-string
                     (propertize (format "%s%s\n" (make-string (current-indentation) ?\s) text)
                                 'face 'my/jacoco-lens-face))
        (push ov my/java-coverage-overlays))))

  (defun my/java--highlight-missed-line (line tooltip-text)
    "Apply orange underline and add a help-echo (tooltip)."
    (save-excursion
      (goto-char (point-min))
      (when (= 0 (forward-line (1- line)))
        (let ((ov (make-overlay (line-beginning-position) (line-end-position))))
          (overlay-put ov 'face 'my/jacoco-missed-line-face)
          (overlay-put ov 'help-echo tooltip-text) ;; This is the native Tooltip
          (push ov my/java-coverage-overlays)))))

  ;; Auto-refresh integration
  (advice-add 'my/project-test :after
              (lambda (&rest _) (when my/java-coverage-visible (my/java-apply-subtle-coverage))))
#+end_src
